weapons.description: SFB features a wide variety of weapons, divided into direct-fire and seeking weapons. Each weapon has range bands that affect hit probability and damage.

directFire.description: Weapons that travel in a straight line from the firing ship. Require line-of-fire and are subject to firing arcs.

types.name: Phasers
types.description: Standard Federation energy weapon. Also used by Hydrans (gatling phasers) and others. Come in 4 sizes, with Phaser-1 being the largest and most powerful.

sizes.description: Largest phaser, typically on heavy cruisers and dreadnoughts.

fireChart.description: Hit probability and damage by range band. Die roll 1-6 = hit, damage shown.

sizes.description: Smallest phaser, used on shuttles and small craft. Energy cost 2.

types.overload: Overloaded phasers score double damage but are limited to 8 hexes range (range band 3 maximum).
types.firingArc: Varies by mount. Designations include F (Forward), LF (Left-Forward), RF (Right-Forward), L (Left), R (Right), LR (Left-Rear), RR (Right-Rear), A (All-around).

types.name: Disruptors
types.description: Klingon and Romulan energy weapon. Functions similarly to phasers but with different damage profiles. Energy cost to fire = 2 (overload: 2+2).

fireChart.description: Standard disruptor fire chart. HIT = die roll range to hit, DMG = damage points.

types.overload: Overloaded disruptors score double damage, limited to 8 hexes (range band 3 maximum).

types.name: Photon Torpedoes
types.description: Federation direct-fire projectile weapon. Limited ammunition. Features 'dial-a-yield' for adjustable warhead strength instead of standard overload. Energy cost to fire = 2+2.

fireChart.description: Photon torpedo fire chart with dial-a-yield. Standard damage = 8 at all ranges. Dial-a-yield adds +2 or +4 power for increased damage.

dialAYield.description: Instead of overloading, photon torpedoes allow the player to add extra energy to increase warhead yield.

types.name: Torpedoes (Klingon/Romulan)
types.description: Projectile weapons used by Klingons and Romulans, analogous to photon torpedoes.

types.name: Fusion Beams
types.description: Hydran energy weapon. Scores half-again damage when overloaded (not double).

types.name: Lasers
types.description: Energy weapons used by various empires. Come in light, medium, and heavy variants.

types.name: Polarons
types.description: Romulan energy weapon variant. Phased polaron cannons are also available.

seeking.description: Weapons that can turn and pursue targets after launch. Can force targets to maneuver to avoid being hit.

types.name: Plasma Torpedoes
types.description: Seeking weapon that pursues targets. Warhead strength degrades over distance. Cannot be held in tractor beams. Each launcher has a once-per-scenario feint launch that costs no energy.
characteristics: Can be disrupted by phaser fire
Cannot be held by tractor beams
Forces targets to maneuver to avoid
Each launcher has one feint launch per scenario (no energy cost)
Most types are self-guiding — launching ship can cloak and leave the torpedo to pursue

variants.description: Standard plasma torpedo. Warhead degrades from 8 to 0 over 30+ hexes.
Romulan plasma with trilithium isotope warhead. Stronger initial warhead.
Variant with different characteristics. Canisters can be carried by fighters.

interception.description: Plasma torpedoes can be intercepted by phaser fire.
interception.method: Phaser fire at the plasma torpedo can reduce its warhead strength or destroy it.
interception.tractorBeam: Cannot be held by tractor beams (only drones can).

types.name: Drones
types.description: Seeking munitions with fixed warhead strength. Limited ammunition. Can be held in tractor beams. Require seeking weapon control channel to guide (not self-guiding).
characteristics: Warhead strength remains constant until impact
Can be held in tractor beams
Require seeking weapon control channel — not self-guiding (launching ship must guide)
Seeking weapon control can be transferred to allied ships

types.description: Standard slow drones. Half warhead strength of modern drones. Included free with drone racks.
Double warhead slow drones. Can be swapped 2:1 with Type-I at resupply.
Standard modern drones.
Advanced drones.

interception.description: Drones can be intercepted by point-defense fire and tractor beams.

resupply.description: Drones are restocked at bases. First load at full price, identical reloads free.
resupply.carrierStorage: Carriers may store drones for fighters at half-price.

types.name: Tholian Web
types.description: Tholian device that casts a web in a hex, restricting movement and fire of ships within it.

types.name: Mines
types.description: Pre-placed explosive devices that detonate when ships enter their hex.

types.name: Transporter Bombs (T-Bombs)
types.description: Explosives beamed onto enemy ships or placed in their path. Favorite tactic of the Andromedans.

types.name: Tractor-Repulsor Beams
types.description: Andromedan variant of tractor beams used as primary weapons. Shake targets to pieces.

types.name: Planet Killers
types.description: Extremely powerful weapons capable of destroying planets.

types.name: Plasmatic Pulsar Device
types.description: ISC weapon. Scores half-again damage when overloaded.

types.name: Warp-Augmented Rail Gun
types.description: Jindarian heavy weapon. Requires two consecutive turns to arm.

types.name: Variable-Focus Neutron Beam
types.description: Eneen heavy weapon. Can be fired in narrow aperture (hit-or-miss) or wide aperture (spread damage).

firingArcs.description: Direct-fire weapons have prescribed arcs of fire. Combined designations simplify notation.

rangeBands.description: Weapons have different effectiveness at different ranges. Each weapon has its own weapons chart showing hit probabilities and damage by range band.

bands.name: Close
bands.description: Highest hit probability and damage for most weapons.

bands.name: Medium
bands.description: Moderate hit probability. Maximum range for overloaded weapons.

bands.name: Extreme
bands.description: Lowest hit probability. Overloaded weapons cannot reach this range.
